action: Edit the SECOND reference pose sheet to use exactly the man and rendering style from the FIRST reference (the integrated four-view Krusher busts). FIRST reference is the new identity/style authority: broad natural adult jaw, short swept brown hair, blue-grey eyes, light beard/stubble and moustache, subdued cool-neutral skin and realistic matte miniature rendering matching the utility-suit body. SECOND reference is ONLY for camera directions, pitch and grid layout; completely replace its chunky retro pixel-art style, orange skin and overly crisp outlines. Fine low-contrast semi-realistic game-sprite shading, soft antialiased contours and fine hair texture, no large painted pixel blocks, no cartoon/vector faces, no glossy lighting. The man must have one consistent physical skull scale in all six cells, and a short anatomically complete skin neck with natural chin/nape shadow, cut where it enters a high collar, not a long triangular stalk. NO clothes, collars, suit or helmet: head and skin-neck cutouts only, truly transparent background, no halos/shadows behind, labels or frames. Exactly six separate cutouts in 3 columns x 2 rows. TOP: front upright control, strict right-facing profile bowed 30 degrees, strict left-facing profile bowed 30 degrees. BOTTOM: front bowed 25 degrees, front bowed 50 degrees, rear view slight bow. All chin angles visibly differ from upright.
